decisions.reason: The existing message-146 MODIFY already states that no-code mints send the $5 commission and tickets to a random existing NFT holder.
The source changes rewards for mints without a referral code; the coded-referral commission and ticket award remain unchanged.
Awarding Small and Big Block tickets on no-code mints does not change their existing counters, eligibility windows, or post-draw reset rules.
The no-code reward rule does not change the mint number's role, persistence, or display locations as a referral code.
The source does not change the Big Block winner count, prize amount, or draw condition.
The $5 commission amount is already represented in mint allocation; directing it to a random holder when no code is used does not change the existing allocation amounts.
The source changes ticket and commission recipients for no-code mints, not the Chainlink VRF winner-selection method or fairness rules.
The no-code reward change does not alter the Small Block prize amount, winner count, eligible ticket population, or trigger.
The source decision concerns primary mints without referral codes and does not change secondary-sale royalty enforcement or amount.
Awarding tickets on no-code mints does not change the manual prize-claim workflow, Winners page, or one-click claim interaction.
The source changes reward recipients for no-code mints but does not change which sale types fund prize pools or the funding duration.
The no-code commission and ticket rule does not change referral badge thresholds or badge-award conditions.
